written.headline: Avicena raises $100M+ Series C for microLED optical interconnects
written.summary: Avicena raised over $100 million in a Series C funding round led by Intervest to commercialize its microLED-based optical interconnect technology for AI infrastructure. The funding included participation from corporate venture arms such as SK Hynix, Samsung, and AMD.

written.headline: Chariot AI unveils Chariot-1 LLM and speech models under IndiaAI Mission
written.summary: Chariot AI has launched the Chariot-1 model suite under the IndiaAI Mission, featuring an 11-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts language model and a text-to-speech system supporting 10 Indian languages. The models were pre-trained from scratch in India and incorporate research innovations designed to improve computational efficiency and reduce token usage.

written.headline: IndiaMART settles dispute with OpenAI over ChatGPT link exclusions
written.summary: IndiaMART settled its legal dispute with OpenAI out of court after alleging that ChatGPT selectively excluded its website and seller listings from AI responses. The Calcutta High Court dismissed the appeal on November 17 following the settlement.

written.headline: Texas resumes data center permitting and approves SpaceX gas plant
written.summary: Texas resumed data center permitting by approving permits for SpaceX's $24 billion gas power plant. The approval occurred ahead of Democratic Governor Gina Hinojosa taking office in January.
